brief.title: Decode and measure every frame of a cut into a digest-pinned cache
brief.plain_summary: Decode an encoded video cut locally with FFmpeg, hash its exact bytes, measure temporal differences, luminance, camera shift and blend fit on every frame, and measure text boxes, panels, chips and edge densities on spatial frames.
brief.outcome: A local measurement cache pinned to the video SHA-256.
